title: Parents Are Using Their Home Equity to Help Their Kids Buy Houses — Just North of Toronto
excerpt: "More GTA parents are unlocking the equity they’ve built over decades to help their kids buy real homes — not tiny condos. NorthSide GTA towns like Georgina, Stouffville, and Newmarket just to name a few, are closer than most people think — and for the first time in years, ownership actually makes sense again."
featureImageAlt: Parents hugging their adult children in the driveway of a detached suburban home at sunset in the NorthSide GTA.
